equity.level_reason: The report's own data cover only black females, so race defines the population; disparities are cited from other reports and raised as background and recommendation. Age results are reported without social-position framing.

level_alternative.reason: The Discussion frames NHAS goals as targets for black females, so the quantified shortfall of linkage (50.1% vs 85%) could be read as a shortfall from a target for an SPD-defined population.

equity.equity_measurement: Only black females are analyzed; racial disparity figures (62% of diagnoses vs 13% of population) are cited from surveillance reports. The 85% linkage target applies to all newly diagnosed persons. Census region is geography, not an SPD.

view_issues: Table caption says testing events are among females with newly diagnosed HIV, though they cover all tested black females. The 13–19 row shows 32 (32.7) for both 2012 linkage and partner services, possibly duplicated.
